title: Experienced Legal Assistant Commercial Property
description:
Experienced Legal Assistant Commercial Property
Salary: £27,000 - £30,000 DOE
Location: Northampton

SJC Legal is currently working with a well-established and highly regarded law firm looking to recruit an experienced Legal Assistant to join its growing Commercial Property team in Northampton.

This is an excellent opportunity for an established Legal Assistant or Legal Secretary who enjoys working within a busy property department and is looking for a long-term legal support position. You will work closely with experienced Commercial Property fee earners, providing essential administrative and transactional support and playing an important role in the smooth running of the department.

The Benefits
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Full-time, permanent position
- Opportunity to join an established and expanding Commercial Property team
- Work directly alongside experienced Commercial Property fee earners
- Exposure to a broad range of commercial property transactions
- Established and highly regarded regional law firm
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Varied and responsible legal support position

The Role
- Provide day-to-day administrative and legal support to Commercial Property fee earners
- Assist with the progression of commercial property transactions
- Submit online property searches
- Prepare and submit Land Registry applications
- Assist with the completion and submission of Stamp Duty Land Tax returns
- Support the team with quality, compliance and file management requirements
- Prepare, format, scan and organise legal documentation and correspondence
- Maintain accurate records using the firm's Case Management system
- Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple fee earners
- Liaise professionally with clients and other third parties
- Provide additional administrative support to other teams when required

The Candidate
- Be an experienced Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or Property Assistant
- Have previous experience working within a legal property environment
- Commercial Property experience would be highly advantageous
- Have strong administrative skills and excellent attention to detail
- Be confident using Case Management systems
- Audio typing and digital dictation experience would be advantageous but is not essential
- Be comfortable working in an administrative and legal support-focused position
- Have excellent organisation and time management skills
- Be able to prioritise competing workloads and work effectively to strict deadlines
- Have a professional and confident telephone manner
- Be proactive, adaptable and enthusiastic with a strong team-focused approach

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, or to discuss other legal support and Commercial Property positions currently available, please contact Alex Wilcock, Legal Recruitment Consultant at SJC Legal.

title: Payroll Administrator
company: Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our superb client, based in Northampton, is seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join them on a part time permanent basis working 20 hours per week Monday to Friday. Flexibility will be required with the working hours during busy periods.

As Payroll Administrator, you will be responsible for end-to-end payroll processing, making adjustments and amendments, dealing with payroll queries, processing expenses, pension information, bonuses and additional benefits, maintenance of holidays, looking after company business credit cards, preparing monthly management information and reporting, regulatory reporting, adhering to compliance requirements and other related payroll duties.

To be considered for the role of Payroll Administrator, you will have recent and previous end-to-end payroll experience, knowledge of current payroll legislation, strong numerical skills, proficiency in Excel to intermediate level and exceptional attention to detail.

In return, our client is offering a salary of £32,000 - £38,000 (full time equivalent) so £17,778 - £21,111 depending on experience for the part time hours, pension, DIS and private healthcare (after qualifying period), 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays, social events and much more.

Send your CV now for consideration and review.

Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent, contract and temporary recruitment. By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited, your personal data may be added to our database as part of the application process. Our privacy policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.
